decision.authority: This package extracts the three existing Viewer loading, empty, and unavailable messages without editorial changes.

values.empty: Nenhum módulo está visível no viewer neste momento.
values.unavailable: Informações temporariamente indisponíveis. Tente novamente mais tarde.

lifecycleAudit.scope: Viewer page-lifetime controller and public data/adapter boundary only
lifecycleAudit.initialization: One page-load IIFE starts one public data request; a successful non-empty projection mounts and subscribes one adapter. Empty and rejected paths return before adapter subscription.
lifecycleAudit.teardown: Full-page navigation ends the controller lifetime; this extraction adds no listeners, timers, remount path, or asynchronous continuation.
evidence: Loading is rendered before the single CASA_PUBLIC_VIEWER_DATA.load() request resolves.
The failure path clears the root and emits the existing role=alert message; server and adapter exception details remain undisplayed.
The empty projection path preserves role=status and returns before mounting the scene adapter.
No controller behavior or adapter lifecycle code is changed by this copy extraction.
